description: Sydney Catchment (SCA) Upper Canal bridge maintenance works: review of environmental factors is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. The Sydney Catchment (SCA) proposes to carry out maintenance works on SCA Upper Canal bridges. The Canal gravity feeds water from the upper Nepean System dams to Prospect Reservoir via a series of tunnels, open canals, aqueducts and piped sections. Note: This resource was originally published on opengov.nsw.gov.au. The OpenGov website has been retired. Coverage: NSW Government. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
